verdict.rationale:
Extend's docs explicitly cover an Extraction Schema page, confidence scores, and structured extraction workflows, and community feedback confirms real-world use for accurate data extraction. The core capability of supplying a schema and getting structured, validated fields back is directly documented as a first-class feature (extraction/schema, confidence-scores).

missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of extraction accuracy against a supplied JSON schema, and detail on how validation errors/mismatches are surfaced.
